target_customer: Voice AI providers, banks and call centers that need to prove an AI voice agent's identity, plus media platforms needing content provenance
problem: Metadata that identifies AI audio is stripped when files are handled, so listeners and institutions cannot verify who an AI agent is during a phone call.
business_model: Platform license to voice AI providers plus verification services

founders.name: Slavko Kovačević
founders.background_notes: YC page says his work has been cited by Meta, Microsoft, Sony and Adobe.

founders.name: Kosta Pavlović
education: PhD in Computer Science, thesis on watermarking
founders.background_notes: YC launch post says the two worked together for six years.

competitors.name: Resemble AI (PerTh)
competitors.what: Neural audio watermark and deepfake detection
competitors.traction_then: Open-source Perth toolkit released 13 May 2025; claims of near 100 percent detection are vendor claims
competitors.funding_then: Raised $8M per a Voicebot report (date not confirmed)

competitors.name: Digimarc
competitors.what: Audio content authentication via digital watermarking
competitors.traction_then: Announced next generation audio watermarking in July 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Learning-based watermarks must survive phone codecs, compression and noise in real time; the founders have published peer-reviewed benchmark and attack-robustness research.

defensibility.rationale: Deep research know-how and a published benchmark are hard to copy, but Resemble and Digimarc offer rival watermarks and research is public.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals shipped watermarking in 2025; Deepgram's TTS uses DeepMark technology per Deepgram, so at least one voice provider chose DeepMark.

market_need_then: EU AI Act Article 50 transparency rules and rising voice deepfake fraud; company says it signed a first platform license before YC and Deepgram and Muvi announced partnerships (Muvi on 2026-02-09).

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and trust-focused, with phrases such as reinventing trust in voice.

branding.community_and_virality: A research benchmark named DeepMark was published at ICLR 2025 Workshops by the founders; partner announcements by Deepgram and Muvi mention the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: Partner pages from Deepgram and Muvi name the brand, but there is no press about the brand itself and the name resembles the founders' own research benchmark title.

outcome_analysis: DeepMark is an active Fall 2026 company with two PhD founders whose published watermarking research gives them founder market fit and a technical edge. A pre-YC platform license and a Deepgram integration suggest early commercial pull, while Resemble AI and Digimarc remain direct rivals and funding is not verified.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting: VCBacked lists about $879K with a pre-seed in September 2025 and Lighthouse Ventures, Startup-Seeker says $878.6K, Dealroom shows a $125K seed. All are aggregators so none is recorded as a round. Outcome search found no acquisition or shutdown. Competitor funding for Resemble is from a search snippet, not opened. Completeness pass: the pre-seed of about 879K dollars is recorded from VCBacked alone. Caplight dates a pre-seed to 2025-01-23 and lists Katapult Accelerator and Zero One Hundred plus a Montenegro Innovation Fund grant, so the date conflicts. Dealroom's 125K seed is not recorded separately and may be the same funding. No press release found.
